name: Agents API
desc: Run cloud agents on the Codex harness, managed by OpenAI.
desc_zh: 在 Codex harness 上运行云端 Agent，由 OpenAI 托管。
solves: Building an agent means owning the loop, the tools and the sandbox. The Agents API hands you that harness, and you pay only for the tokens and tools you use.
solves_zh: 自己搭 Agent 就要自己维护循环、工具和沙箱。Agents API 直接给你这套 harness，你只为自己用掉的 token 和工具付费。
best_for: You want an agent in your product and do not want to run the infrastructure.
best_for_zh: 你想在自己的产品里放一个 Agent，又不想自己运维底层设施。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — OpenAI news, https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-agents-api）。 Public beta for all developers on 2026-09-10. Computer use, tool search and context compaction were added at DevDay on 2026-09-29. platform.openai.com/docs/guides/agents redirects to developers.openai.com. 首次公开日期来源：https://openai.com/index/introducing-the-agents-api 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents）。
